Brown & Shaw Law Group
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-5305
Settlement Demand
08/26/2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1193 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents Sara Dvais in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on 06/04/2023. Our client
was lawfully turning left at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of our client's car. The
impact was forceful enough to deploy airbags and cause significant damage to both vehicles. Our client was taken
from the scene by ambulance and later diagnosed with a concussion, which has caused persistent headaches,
dizziness, sensitivity to light, and difficulty concentrating. Our client has been unable to return to work for an extended
period and continues to attend medical appointments and therapy sessions.
The available evidence points clearly to your insured as the party responsible for this collision. Your insured had a
duty to yield to oncoming traffic before proceeding through the intersection and failed to do so. We have enclosed the
medical records, imaging results, repair estimates, and wage documentation supporting our client's claim.
To resolve this matter without litigation, we demand payment of $233,000.00, which reflects medical expenses, lost
income, future care needs, and general damages for pain and suffering. This offer will remain open for thirty days
from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without
further notice.
Expert review: Janet Williams, neurologist
Sincerely,
Debra Moody
Brown & Shaw Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
